detail: Current restaurant operator identifies the original 61 North Avenue address and parking.
Operator dates architect Jules Grey’s curved 1940s facade, expanded indoor dining and replacement Lunching Pad. The 2000 roadside V sign is 45 ft high.
Craig records the surviving Streamlined Moderne porthole and tapered marquee, alternating 1960s panels, rounded renovation glass block and low rear deck. Architectural facts only.
